notes: Production Ghost uses its own MySQL rather than unsupported development-mode SQLite; MySQL 8.0 matches Ghost 5 authentication support.
Ghost connects as a dedicated database user, never root, with separate app and root secrets.
The content volume preserves uploaded images and themes, while the database holds posts; the owner account is created through the setup wizard.
